emails.body:

emails.subject: regional office footprint across markets

For companies operating across 18+ countries with over 1,400 staff, real estate management often becomes fragmented. Operations teams usually end up juggling disparate long-term leases and inconsistent office setups in every new country.

Does that match what you are seeing at Perfios, or do you have regional workspace management streamlined?

Best,
agneshmp07@gmail.com

emails.subject: flexible workspace for perfios's next growth phase
emails.body:
With Nitin Chugh coming on board as Group CEO to drive Perfios's next phase of growth, office needs will likely evolve quickly across your teams.

If we brought you a flexible workspace strategy that lets your teams expand into new markets with move-in ready offices without long-term lease commitments, would you be open to taking a look? A yes commits you to nothing and costs nothing.

Best,
